name: Lammia
ability: Each Night*, pick a player, learn their character, then choose if they die. If you choose no, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

name: Party Host
ability: If at least one of your alive neighbors is poisoned or drunk, you cannot die.
flavor: Let’s keep this party going all night!

name: Solemdeath
ability: Once per game, you may build a world in front of the storyteller learn how close you are to the correct world.
flavor: Before the games ends, I would like to alsaahir guess that....

name: Groundskeeper
ability: You start knowing if your neighbors are the same character type.
flavor: In cleaning up others messes, you learn quite a bit about your community.

name: Paladin
ability: You start knowing a player that is not the demon. If the player you know dies, you learn another player that is not the demon tonight.
flavor: A real warrior doesn’t battle with a sword. It fights with the heart.

name: Ash
ability: Something bad happens to Ash. [+Bidoof’s Wheel]

name: Bidoof’s Wheel
ability: Each night, 3 prompts are given. Choose one to happen to Ash. If Ash dies learn this. [+Ash]
flavor: Hmmmmm what will I do this time?
